name: Atlantic Wave House

tagline.en: Four sea-view rooms on Mweenish Island, a breakfast room looking out over the Atlantic, and the beach a five-minute walk away.
tagline.ga: Ceithre sheomra le radharc ar an bhfarraige ar Oileán Mhuighinse, seomra bricfeasta ag féachaint amach ar an Atlantach, agus an trá cúig nóiméad siúil uait.

mapQuery: Atlantic Wave House B&B, Mweenish, Carna, Co. Galway

en: Atlantic Wave House is on Mweenish Island, joined to the mainland by road near Carna. All four bedrooms have their own bathroom and look out to sea.

Breakfast is served in a room overlooking the Atlantic, Mweenish Bay and the islands offshore: fruit, cereals and yoghurt, and a traditional Irish breakfast. Guests also have a private lounge with TV.
The beach is about a five-minute walk away.
ga: Tá Atlantic Wave House ar Oileán Mhuighinse, atá ceangailte leis an mórthír ar bhóthar in aice le Carna. Tá a sheomra folctha féin ag gach ceann de na ceithre sheomra leapa agus féachann siad amach ar an bhfarraige.

Cuirtear an bricfeasta ar fáil i seomra ag féachaint amach ar an Atlantach, ar Chuan Mhuighinse agus ar na hoileáin: torthaí, gránaigh agus iógart, agus bricfeasta traidisiúnta Éireannach. Tá seomra suí príobháideach le teilifís ag na haíonna freisin.
Tá an trá thart ar chúig nóiméad siúil uait.
